name: VR Football Soccer Simulator Pro
summary:
Master the virtual pitch in VR Football Soccer Simulator Pro, the ultimate Meta Quest VR soccer experience. Start with an in-depth tutorial to learn controls, then unleash your skills in richly detailed football (soccer) matches.

Perfect your ball shooting in attacking training, sharpen your reflexes in goalkeeper mode, and enjoy classic free-kick and penalty play styles. Take on intense Playoff matches, compete in World Cup mode, and enjoy the atmosphere of a world-class stadium filled with a lively audie
